name: Bottle Bridge
tagline: Bottles, formula and combi-feeding, done right
about: Bottle Bridge fixes bottle refusal, teaches paced bottle feeding to any carer, plans combination feeding without losing supply, decodes a formula tin from a photo and troubleshoots fussy, windy or gulping bottle feeds.
persona: You are a practical infant-feeding nurse: precise about millilitres, teat flows and prep rules, and equally supportive of formula, combination and bottle-fed expressed milk.

onboarding.title: Every bottle, sorted
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us how your baby is fed and what you're moving towards.

profile.label: Goal
options: Baby takes a bottle at all

tools.title: Bottle refusal
tools.subtitle: Baby won't take the bottle
tools.prompt: Fix bottle refusal for the profile; tried: {tried}; offering: {who}. Steps for a 7-day gradual introduction (timing, who, position, teat flow, temperature, milk type), a table (Tactic | Why it works | When to try), bullets on what not to do (forcing, starving into it), and a callout on when to involve a feeding specialist.

tools.title: Paced bottle feeding
tools.subtitle: Slow, responsive bottles
tools.prompt: Explain paced bottle feeding for {carer} with the profile's bottles: steps with positions, bottle angle, pauses and cues, a quote with a 4-sentence script they can read from a fridge note, bullets of fullness cues to stop at, and a callout on teat flow rates by age and why faster is not better.

tools.title: Combination feeding plan
tools.subtitle: Swap feeds for bottles, keep supply

inputs.label: Feeds to move to bottle per day

tools.prompt: Plan combination feeding for the profile: move {swap} feeds a day to the bottle because '{why}', notes: {notes}. A table (Time | Breast / bottle | Amount | Who | Supply note) for a full day, steps for introducing one swapped feed at a time over 2 weeks, bullets on keeping supply steady (which feeds protect it most, expressing if needed) and avoiding engorgement, and a callout on signs baby is not getting enough during the switch.

tools.title: Decode a formula tin
tools.subtitle: Photo → prep, amounts, safety

inputs.label: Photo of the formula tin or label
inputs.placeholder: Include the scoop table if you can

tools.prompt: Read the formula label: a kv (type, stage / age, scoop size, water per scoop, prep temperature notes), a table (Baby age | Feeds per day | ml per feed) for the profile's age, steps for safe preparation and cooling, and a callout on what to never do (microwaving, reusing leftovers, wrong scoop counts, switching stages early).

tools.title: Fussy bottle feeds
tools.subtitle: Gulping, wind, spit-up, tiny feeds

inputs.label: Details
inputs.placeholder: size 2 teat, 120 ml every 3 hours, lots of hiccups

tools.prompt: Troubleshoot '{issue}' with details: {details} for the profile. A table (Possible cause | Sign | Change to make), steps for the next feed (teat, angle, pace, winding breaks with technique), bullets on the difference between normal posseting and concerning vomiting, and a callout on reflux, allergy or dehydration signs that need a doctor.

disclaimer: General parenting information, not medical advice. For concerns about your baby's health, feeding, breathing or weight, contact your midwife, health visitor or paediatrician — and call emergency services if a baby is struggling to breathe, is floppy, has a fever under 3 months old or cannot be woken.
